about_the_game:
About the Demo Version of Niraya of ■■

Experience the opening of Niraya of ■■, a Japanese-style horror adventure where you guide a child named Yuni through a haunted world in search of the way home.

In this third-person horror adventure, you take control of a young, defenseless protagonist, navigating an eerily silent world while evading its monstrous threats.

◆ Demo Version Scope

  • Play through the opening section of the game, up to the end of the first area.

  • Experience the unique setting, and begin to uncover the unsettling reality Yuni faces.

  • Estimated playtime: approximately 20–30 minutes.

◆ Differences from the Full Version

  • Some items' effects are disabled for the demo version.

  • Save data will not carry over to the full version.

  • Key configuration and advanced graphics settings are not available.

  • Achievements are not supported.

◆ To Our Players

We invite you to immerse yourself in the uneasy stillness of this world—and to feel the quiet urgency of one simple wish: "Please, help bring this child home."

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10
  • Processor: Intel CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GEFORCE GTX 1660 Ti or AMD RADEON RX 6500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows11
  • Processor: Intel CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GEFORCE 2080 Ti or AMD RADEON RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device

short_description: Third-person Japanese-style horror adventure. Awakening in the aftermath of an arcane ritual, Yuni is stranded in a strange world. Haunting premonitions of danger are the child's only means to evade—and escape. Please... Help guide Yuni safely home.
